title: Run the push-images workflow structure test after editing the workflow
answers: how to test changes to push-images.yml
run the docker image workflow test locally
workflow test fails after editing the image promotion script
check that docker tag promotion steps are still wired correctly
body:
Run: `UV_FROZEN=1 uv run pytest tests/test_push_images_workflow.py`.
The test loads .github/workflows/push-images.yml with yaml.safe_load and asserts job names, `needs`, `permissions`, `concurrency`, `flavor: latest=false` on each metadata-action step, and step order (validation before the first push).
It also matches exact strings in the promotion `run` script, including the full `docker buildx imagetools create --prefer-index=false --tag ... "ghcr.io/mlflow/...:$RELEASE_TAG"` command for all three images.
Any edit to those commands, step names, or the Latest-check wording needs a matching update to the test, or the test fails even when the workflow is valid.
Run the repo pre-commit hooks `check-github-workflows` and `check-actions` as well.
